The same chain as illegible-figure.md, with scale=0.33 already on the fence:
the advice repeated scale=0.33 to it. A row laid out sideways turns first.

```d2 caption="Too wide to read" scale=0.33
direction: right
n1: Nodo numero uno
n2: Nodo numero dos
n3: Nodo numero tres
n4: Nodo numero cuatro
n5: Nodo numero cinco
n6: Nodo numero seis
n7: Nodo numero siete
n8: Nodo numero ocho
n9: Nodo numero nueve
n10: Nodo numero diez
n1 -> n2 -> n3 -> n4 -> n5 -> n6 -> n7 -> n8 -> n9 -> n10
```
